exposure: ultrasound-guided local lauromacrogol injection (USG-LLI) combined with curettage and hysteroscopy
uterine artery embolization (UAE) combined with curettage and hysteroscopy
cohort: 151 CSP patients diagnosed with CSP from June 2017 to December 2019
finding: USG-LLI combined with curettage and hysteroscopy was as effective as UAE in treating CSP, but with lower complication rates and lower total costs.
